notes: The size guide is H&M's general guide for tops, shirts, jackets and blazers, opened from this product's page; it is not specific to this T-shirt.
H&M publishes no garment measurements for this product, so its length, sleeve, shoulder and garment chest are unknown.
"Regular fit" describes this product only; other H&M T-shirts are sold as slim, relaxed and oversized.
